title: Resolve upstream integration conflicts without silently losing fork changes
summary: When an authorized fork integration produces competing edits, identify the affected fork-specific patches and upstream changes, choose an explicit resolution supported by the approved task, and verify that intended behavior is preserved; never treat an automatic merge or rebase result as authorization to discard a local customization.
statement: When an authorized fork integration produces competing edits, identify the affected fork-specific patches and upstream changes, choose an explicit resolution supported by the approved task, and verify that intended behavior is preserved; never treat an automatic merge or rebase result as authorization to discard a local customization.
rationale: Independent normalization of SPEC-0136. Record consequential resolutions and check semantic conflicts even without textual merge markers. Existing overlapping general rules remain independently selectable.

conditions: When authorized upstream integration affects local behavior or patches.
exceptions: Behavioral changes and unresolved conflicts must be surfaced; do not invent authorization to discard customizations.
